lines.text: The Israelites camped at Oboth, Iye-abarim, and the Valley of Zered, then camped on the other side of the Arnon.
At Beer, the LORD told Aaron to gather the people, and Israel sang about the well the princes dug.
Israel asked Sihon for passage, but he attacked at Jahaz, and Israel took his land from Arnon to Jabbok.
Israel captured Heshbon, Sihon's city, and Sihon had earlier fought the former king of Edom.
Og king of Bashan came out to battle at Edrei, but Israel struck him down and took his land.
